Oh! Pop!
How does Puppy feel? Tap the face.
How does Puppy feel?
Yes. Puppy feels sad because the balloon popped.
Hmm. Watch Puppy again.
Can you help Puppy? Get a new balloon.

Yes. Penguin feels thankful because Cow shared the umbrella.
Hmm. Watch Penguin again.

How does Fox feel?
Yes. Fox feels jealous because Tiger has a new bike and Fox wants one too.
Hmm. Watch Fox again.

You invited Octopus to play. Now Octopus has a friend!
